overlap: Do not overlap the two implementation windows or post-run evaluators with an implementation window.
variable: version-required PRD table and benchmark schema
independently produced implementation and meaningful additional tests

clock.requestToReceipt: First implementation handoff submitted until CLI receipt finalized timestamp; includes skill reading, prepare-run and workflow handling after handoff.
clock.runToReceipt: CLI state start through finalized receipt; strict completion required.
clock.overlap: Report wall-clock unions and resource sums separately; never sum nested or concurrent durations as elapsed time.
clock.incomplete: Record observed duration and exact blocker; never label a stopped run as completion time.
clock.evaluation: Post-receipt analysis is separate and excluded from implementation duration.

honesty: No prior implementation or previous result provided to executors
No PRD change during run without existing applicable human authority
No failure deletion, budget reset, fake identity, diagnostic judge override or global rollback
One pair is an exploratory observation, not a general speedup estimate
Raw benchmark reports remain in their native schemas; do not fake strict cross-schema comparability
delivery: Local isolated benchmark artifacts and ordinary preservation commits only; no push, PR, deployment or global install changes.
